## Summary

**Remove internal scrollbars from mandatory triage panels**

Scope, action, handoff and help panels hide required content behind internal scrolling.

## Priority / wave

- Priority: **P0**
- Wave: **V1**
- Complexity: **M**
- Audit code: `UX-P0-02`
- DUX code: `DUX5-02`

## Scope

Run Explorer, Incident Workspace, Data Quality, Overview, Trust.

Screenshot groups: SG-01 Run Explorer, SG-02 Incident, SG-03 DQ, SG-06 Overview, SG-07 Trust

## Concrete change

Auto-size required text panels to a strict 2–4 line budget. Move documentation and endpoints to descriptions, tooltips and runbook links.

## Expected effect

The first action and reason remain visible at 100% and 125% zoom.

## Acceptance criteria

- Zero internal vertical scrollbars in first-screen status/reason/action panels at 1366×768, 1440×900 and 1920×1080.
- Aligns with epic acceptance: Status/Reason/Impact/Action visible without internal scroll on first viewport
- No new high-cardinality Prometheus labels
- No hidden verdict logic introduced only in Grafana transforms

## Dependencies

Copy rewrite and grid reflow.

## Risk

Taller panels may push diagnostics below fold; this is acceptable when priority is preserved.

## Overlap / predecessor notes

Hardens DUX4-22: screenshot audit still shows internal scroll on mandatory triage panels.

## Constraints

- Surgical dashboard JSON only; preserve panel IDs where possible
- Run Explorer remains forensic owner when moving detail off domain boards
- Prefer description/runbook for caveats; keep first-screen copy to 2-4 lines
- Tech-debt budgets non-increasing

## Verification

- [ ] Before/after screenshots for affected panels (dark theme)
- [ ] Viewports: 1366x768, 1440x900, 1920x1080 at 100% (125% when layout-sensitive)
- [ ] Targeted pytest for navigation/contracts if JSON structure changes
- [ ] Manual operator 5-second comprehension check on first-screen card

## Parent

DUX5 epic (#7116)
